changeSet.author: hephaestus

preConditions.onFailMessage: idx_llm_usage_occurred_at already exists and is valid
preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_index i ON i.indexrelid = c.oid WHERE c.relname = 'idx_llm_usage_occurred_at' AND i.indisvalid

changeSet.comment: Serve the retention sweep's age-only predicate, which the workspace-leading composite cannot.
changeSet.sql: DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF EXISTS idx_llm_usage_occurred_at; CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS idx_llm_usage_occurred_at ON llm_usage_event (occurred_at);

rollback.sql: DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF EXISTS idx_llm_usage_occurred_at;
